note: Sparse mirror of the open-licensed real-data inputs of builder/full_investigation/real/fi_build_real.py (R09, R11, R12), laid out like GB_REAL_DATA_DIR (.context/real_data). 'copy' files are byte-identical to the originals; 'slice' files keep only the rows the builder uses (rule given); 'extract' files hold, in another format, only what the builder reads from an original it cannot parse with the standard library (rule given). Inputs marked mirror 'none' in fi_sources.py (posts, web pages, NESO website statements and the quoted GOV.UK and Ofgem pages) are not copied. No report PDF is copied. Written by builder/full_investigation/real/fi_sync_raw.py.
